en.io: Input: list, show <id>, cancel <id|--all>, or prune. Output: grouped status tables, buffer contents, cancellation confirmations, or prune counts.
en.boundary: Does not launch agents or modify source code. When live cancellation is unavailable it only marks registry state and discards later results; the underlying agent may continue until completion or timeout. Prune is limited to terminal-state records and buffers older than seven days.
scenarios: List running, completed, stalled, or errored background work.
Read a completed agent's output buffer.
Cancel one or all running agents.
Prune terminal-state buffers older than seven days.

zh.io: 输入：list、show <id>、cancel <id|--all> 或 prune。输出：分组状态表、缓冲区内容、取消确认或清理计数。
zh.boundary: 不会启动代理或修改源代码。无法实时取消时，只更新注册表状态并丢弃后续结果，底层代理可能继续运行到完成或超时。修剪仅处理超过七天的终态记录和缓冲区。
dependencies: 可用时的提供方取消 API
scenarios: 列出运行中、已完成、停滞或出错的后台任务。
读取已完成代理的输出缓冲区。
取消一个或全部运行中代理。
清理超过七天的终态缓冲区。
